label: Fire Damage
description: On hit: deal additional Fire damage.

label: Frost Damage
description: On hit: deal additional Frost damage.

label: Shock Damage
description: On hit: deal additional Shock damage.

label: Drain Magicka
description: On hit: drain Y Magicka from the target.

label: Drain Health
description: On hit: drain Y Health from the target.

label: Drain Stamina
description: On hit: drain Y Stamina (fatigue) from the target.

label: Paralyze
description: On hit: inflict the Paralyzed condition on the target for SL rounds.

label: Silence
description: On hit: inflict the Silenced condition on the target for SL rounds.

label: Dispel
description: On hit: attempt to dispel magical effects on the target with Dispel Strength = SL.

label: Disintegrate
description: On hit: apply the Damaged(SL) quality to the target's equipped weapon or armor.
notes: type must be 'weapon' or 'armor'. Applies Damaged(SL) quality.

label: Soul Trap
description: On hit: marks the target's soul. If the target dies while the effect is active, their soul is trapped in the wielder's soul gem.
notes: Fixed cost 50. Integrates with the existing Soul Trap pipeline.

label: Absorb Health
description: On hit: drain Y Health from the target and restore it to the wielder.

label: Turn Undead
description: On hit: forces undead targets to flee for SL rounds.
